audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Mordekaiser wins Level 1 and Mordekaiser wins 2+ items, contradicting the packet chart (Skill / Irelia) and the existing whys text, which says Level 1 is even and that Irelia out-DPSes him at two items.
audit.why: Mordekaiser has no dash and no Level 1 shove tool that beats Bladesurge farming; at 2+ items Irelia's reset uptime plus on-hit magic damage beats a dashless juggernaut outside Realm of Death.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Skill (5/10), 2+ items = Irelia (7/10); both layers flipped together.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Irelia's E-stun window at 2-3, Mordekaiser's Realm of Death at 6 (140/120/100s), his first AP item, and Irelia's 2-item reclaim.
audit.corrected: phases[6].why rewritten so the 2-item row states Irelia's spike instead of warning about his carry threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, winCon, dosFull[2] and report[1] all told the player to "W-block his burst". Irelia's W (Defiance) reduces PHYSICAL damage only, per Riot's text; Mordekaiser's damage is magic.
audit.why: Riot kit text for Irelia W: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Mordekaiser's Obliterate, Darkness Rise aura and Realm of Death are magic damage, so W provides no mitigation in this matchup.
audit.corrected: W is a trade/charge tool here, never a defensive answer to his burst. Real answers: dodge Death's Grasp (700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s), keep dying minions beside you for Bladesurge resets so his isolated Obliterate bonus never applies, and refuse fights while Realm of Death is up.

audit.why: Realm of Death at 140s rank 1 is the punishable window; Death's Grasp is 16s at rank 1 and Obliterate only 8s.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added to the don'ts so the advice is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible (W) heals the damage he stores, and the do's block titled 'Build MR' carried unrelated trading text with no anti-heal instruction.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Mordekaiser sustains through chip damage, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling before extended trades; MR after Blade of the Ruined King.

edits.before: Stack passive on the wave before any trade. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — he has no dash and only Death's Grasp reach on you. Stack passive on the wave and stay outside his 700-unit pull.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: full Bladesurge reset uptime and on-hit magic damage out-DPS a dashless juggernaut. Outside his R, the side lane is yours.

edits.before: His R isolates you from Q targets — build MR and W his burst.
edits.after: Realm of Death cuts your resets — dodge his E, duel at 2 items.

edits.before: Build MR and W-block his realm burst. Track Realm of Death before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Never fight with Realm of Death up. Keep dying minions near for resets, buy anti-heal, then win the 2-item duel.

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Mordekaiser when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.
edits.after: Indestructible (W) heals stored damage back — Executioner's Calling before long trades, MR after Blade of the Ruined King.

edits.after: Its damage cut is physical only — W trades here, it never saves you from him.

edits.after: It pulls you off the wave so his Q lands isolated for extra damage.

edits.after: Obliterate hits far harder when you're alone and is back every 8s at rank 1 — keep minions beside you.

notes: Point 4 correction is the important one: the page repeatedly told players to block Mordekaiser's burst with Irelia's W, but Defiance reduces physical damage only (Riot text) and all of Mordekaiser's damage is magic. Level chart rows 0 and 6 were fixed in matched full/content pairs. Anti-heal (Executioner's Calling) added per missingInteractions. suspectNames flag on whys[4] is a false positive — 'Realm of Death' is the correct R name.
